correctness.rationale: Under probability surface measure on S³ the reproducing kernel is (ℓ+1)U_ℓ(x·y), with diagonal (ℓ+1)². The two regular orthogonal circles produce equal n×n circulant Gram blocks plus constant cross-blocks (ℓ+1)U_ℓ(0). The exponential Fourier expansion U_ℓ(cosθ)=Σ_{j=0}^ℓ exp(i(ℓ−2j)θ) gives each nonzero frequency eigenvalue n(ℓ+1)c_a twice, while the two constant modes have eigenvalues n(ℓ+1)(c_0±s_ℓ). Exactly min(m,ℓ+1) occupied parity-residues and c_0(2k)=1+2⌊k/m⌋ imply ranks 2min(m,ℓ+1) for odd ℓ, 2min(m,ℓ+1)−1 for even ℓ<2m, and 2m for even ℓ≥2m. The constant-mode null eigenvector proves signed circle-sum quadrature for even ℓ<2m; direct multiplicities at ℓ=2m−2,2m−1,2m give tight and √2-conditioning transitions, and asymptotic residue counts imply condition number→1. Checked m=2, ℓ=0 and independent phases in the argument. Independently built raw addition-kernel matrices and compared all eigenvalues for 248 (m,ℓ) cases m=2..9, ℓ=0..30; these finite eigenspectra corroborate but do not prove all m,ℓ.
